name: Tame or Conquered
source:
You got isekai'd, only to wake up as a cursed saintess. You have 6 months to choose a husband from 7 yandere red flags.. or become a big tree and die. A "simple" psychological horror & dark romance VN.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5014200/Tame_or_Conquered/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你穿越到了异世界，一觉醒来却成了身负诅咒的圣女。你必须在6个月内从7名浑身危险信号的病娇男中挑出一位结为夫婿……否则就会变成一棵大树一命呜呼！一部“简简单单”的心理恐怖兼暗黑恋爱视觉小说。

[摘自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/5014200/Tame_or_Conquered/]Steam[/url]]
